questions.question: A technician is troubleshooting a desktop PC that is plugged into a UPS. The PC loses the system date/time after every power outage. Which of the following should the technician do to resolve the issue? (Choose two.)
options: A) Run a BIOS update.
B) Swap out the RAM.
C) Disable NTP in the OS.
D) Repair the backup power source.
E) Replace the CMOS battery.
F) Install a surge protector.
questions.explanation: The system date/time resetting after power outages usually means the PC is losing CMOS power, which is commonly caused by a failing CMOS battery or a faulty UPS/backup power source. Repairing the UPS and replacing the CMOS battery restores stable system clock retention.

questions.question: An administrator needs to configure RAID array to support manage storage partitions securely and efficiently. Which action should be taken?
options: A) Enable encryption and verify protocol bindings
B) Disable firewall rules and reset factory defaults
C) Format the primary partition using FAT32
D) Assign a static APIPA address
questions.explanation: Based on CompTIA A+ troubleshooting methodology for 1.0 Mobile Devices, verifying system diagnostics, checking configurations, and isolating the component (RAID array) resolves the issue safely.
